where.screen_path: Phase 5c complete (5c-i + 5c-ii); /#people for inbox + remote handshake; /settings for toggle + custom relays

summary: Phase 5c is structurally complete. Across this session: 5c-i-ε auto-routing, NIP-44 reference-vector interop (10/10 pass), 5c-i-ζ Send-back-via-Nostr, 5c-i-η Send-via-Nostr in CosignRequestModal, 5c-i-θ peer picker from holdings, 5c-i-ι membership auto-receive, 5c-i-κ Send-via-Nostr in MembershipModal, 5c-i-λ operator-editable custom relay list, 5c-ii Tier R remote handshakes (reuses 5c-i routing on receive side), plus auto-dismiss-on-success polish. Branch and main both at 93afbc4. Only 5c-iii (multi-device sync + relay-OK delivery acks) is left in Phase 5c.

why.text: Operator authorized 'continue on until you run out of things to do or need me to do something physically', with a chip-vote for 5c-i-ι first and then 5c-ii. Worked the queue end-to-end. The receive-respond loop closes a real workflow: Alice can now request a co-sign or issue a membership or start a Tier R handshake remotely; Bob's wallet auto-routes, lets him confirm, and ships the reply back; both wallets converge on the dual-signed envelope. The NIP-44 vector test removed the cryptographic faith claim — what the wallet writes, every spec-conformant NIP-44 client can read.

outcome.notes: Branch and main both at 93afbc4. 18 commits landed across this session (10 cuts + the NIP-44 vectors + auto-dismiss + multiple comms close-outs). All cuts pure additions; each independently safe and tested. Sub-cuts of 5c-i and 5c-ii are operator-visible: Settings shows the Mycelium toggle + relay editor; the People tab shows the inbox panel; HandshakeModal has the Tier R path when the toggle is on; CosignRequestModal + MembershipModal have Send-via-Mycelium blocks.

uncertainty: The remote co-sign + Tier R handshake loops have been unit-tested via fake transport + fake WebSocket but not exercised against real public relays. NIP-44 cryptographic interop is verified against spec vectors so the wire format is sound, but real-relay round-trip behavior arrives with the operator's first two-device field test. Today's Sent state confirms WebSocket dispatch, not relay acceptance — 5c-iii's delivery-ack layer addresses that.

cosigning — three modals now accept incoming envelopes and onSuccess callbacks; original paste/QR paths unchanged

next: 5c-iii — multi-device connection sync (the wallet's other devices stay current over Nostr) + delivery acks (Sent state waits for the relay OK frame). Or Phase 5d — Tier V device-verified presence (WebAuthn + geolocation + timestamp). Or operator field test of the full 5c stack with two real devices, which would be the first real-relay evidence and the natural validation before more code lands.
